author: Hebrish
description:
Irish English Sentences
	


  
Audio dataset, split-out. Rows copied from the master, danielrosehill/Read-Aloud-Voice-Sentences, so one task can be browsed alone. Training reads the master, not this copy. Every audio dataset as one tree, with hours: the audio index. How every dataset fits together: the dataset index.


Everyday sentences in Irish English read by one speaker born in Ireland: vocabulary (craic, grand, giving out, press, messages), grammar (I'm after doing it, so it… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Hebrish/Irish-English-Sentences.
